title: AI Snitches Get Glitches: Towards Evading Agentic Surveillance
reasoning: The paper introduces SURVEILBENCH, a benchmark designed to evaluate the ethical and moral decisions of AI agents regarding 'agentic surveillance.' It investigates the conflict between an agent's safety-driven duty to report misconduct (protective reporting) and the potential violation of user privacy (intrusive monitoring), framing these as moral dilemmas governed by societal values and norms.
